notes.title: Update Notes for 1.1.9
notes.notes: Added a toggle in the Graphics menu to disable motion blur.

notes.title: Update 1.1.8 - Secret Room DLC, Simplified Chinese and Subtitles!
notes.notes:
1.1.8 is shipping to celebrate our 1-year anniversary! 

[previewyoutube=2VV3NRVJFAo;full][/previewyoutube]

Detailed notes for the anniversary patch:

- Secret Room DLC! Make sure to install it from Steam when it is officially launched. The Secret Room is unlocked after beating the game at least once on the signed-in account. It contains some heartfelt commentary from the developers, new gameplay with parts of the game that weren't in the final shipped version, and more. There are 6 Developer Commentaries to listen to, try to find them all!
- Subtitles on/off option added (yes, this one is for you Catman)
- Simplified Chinese localization
- Small tweaks and some performance fixes in the rest of the game

Please let us know if you run into any problems in the forums, on our Discord, or mail us... we're here!

notes.title: 1.0.3 PATCH - Visual tweaks and fixes
notes.notes:
Dear The Shattering fans,

We worked on some feedback of yours and are releasing a new patch (1.0.3) to fix some minor issues throughout the game:

- updating and fixing quality of some textures 
- fixed the hints positions
- fixed collisions with some objects
- fixed clipping of some models
- updating Polish translations
- tweaked animations
- tweaked timing of some events and narrations
- tweaked some save points states

Please let us know on the forums if you are having any issues!
